subject: Channel co-fund subsidy and pricing risk-transfer — VP/CFO signoff request
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Minh Tran <minh.tran@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Channel co-fund subsidy request: MarketBridge channel listing + risk-transfer credit

Team — quick ask for signoff. MarketBridge (Dana, cc'd) has pushed for a co-funded channel listing and wants an introductory commercial that blends a listing subsidy with a usage-based discount tied to a 12-month minimum commit. Below is the proposed structure I negotiated with Dana this morning: 

- Co-fund listing subsidy: Redwood pays 50% of MarketBridge listing fee, capped at $50,000, payable as a one-time credit after listing goes live.
- Risk-transfer credit: customer receives a 7.5% unit discount on hosted inference tokens if they commit to a 12-month minimum consumption guarantee (min $200k spend over 12 months).
- Duration & clawback: subsidy valid for first 6 months; clawback on decomm < 9 months on a prorated basis.

Attachments: channel_cofund_terms.pdf (term sheet), marketbridge_deal_summary.xlsx (deal one-pager). I also attached a usage forecast from Dana.

Why I'm asking: MarketBridge is a high-visibility channel for us in Q1 — they bring marketplace discovery and a set of pilot customers. The economics look marginally dilutive in year one but could accelerate net new ARR and partner referrals. Need VP/CFO signoff because this is outside standard discount guardrails and involves a marketing subsidy payment.

Ask: Can Karthik/Marissa/Lauren review and confirm whether we can approve this one-off co-fund (up to $50k) and the conditional unit discount structure? If approved, we need us to confirm (1) exact contract language for the clawback and (2) how to route the subsidy payment (COGS vs. marketing expense).

Quick phone slot: I can be on a 15-min call at 10:30 PT if helpful.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
+aisha@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0147

Attachments: channel_cofund_terms.pdf (term sheet), marketbridge_deal_summary.xlsx (deal one-pager)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Minh Tran <minh.tran@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel co-fund subsidy request: MarketBridge channel listing + risk-transfer credit

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the crisp summary. A couple of quick asks from my side before we escalate to Lauren for finance signoff: 

1) Can you add the expected 12-month ARR profile by month (what does adoption ramp look like?) and the incremental gross margin impact for year 1 vs year 2?
2) If we approve the 7.5% unit discount tied to a consumption guarantee, what's our fallback rate if the customer misses the minimum? (i.e., do we reduce the discount and apply overage pricing?)
3) Confirm whether partner listing fee is one-off or recurring for MarketBridge (Dana mentioned a 'platform activation' fee that may recur annually).

I want to make sure this is gatekept by a clear clawback and a time-limited subsidy line — also prefer the subsidy be budgeted to marketing unless Finance flags otherwise.

I can join the 10:30 slot if helpful.

—Karthik
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Minh Tran <minh.tran@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel co-fund subsidy request: MarketBridge channel listing + risk-transfer credit

Folks — I ran a quick sensitivity on the attached (finance_model_v2.xlsx). Summary below: 

- Base case (50% co-fund up to $50k + 7.5% unit discount with $200k minimum): incremental ARR contribution projected ~ $420k net new ARR over 12 months; year-1 gross margin hit approx -3.2 p.p. (dilutive) due to the one-time subsidy and discounted units.
- Upside case (accelerated adoption + partner referrals): could convert to ~$1.1M ARR by EOY+1 and margins recover to within 0.5 p.p. of plan.
- Cash flow / accounting: subsidy should be booked as a marketing contra-revenue credit (not COGS) to preserve gross margin comparability; we should expense the credit over the subsidy eligibility window to avoid one-off distortions.

Conditions I recommend for approval: 
1) Time-limited subsidy payout (6 months) with a prorated clawback if listing is removed before 9 months.
2) Documented minimum spend ($200k) in SOW + a clear remediation (discount reduction to 0% and standard overage pricing) if minimum not met within the first 12 months.
3) Partner listing fee confirmation (one-off vs annual) before payment — if recurring, cap our liability to one year.
4) Require MarketBridge to sign the partner co-fund Annex (legal to iterate).

If those conditions are added to the term sheet I can approve the commercial in principle and sign off up to the $50k subsidy. I will need Legal to confirm contract language + RevOps to confirm the practical timing/ops for issuing the credit.

Attaching: finance_model_v2.xlsx (sensitivity)

Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance (acting CFO)
Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Minh Tran <minh.tran@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 12:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel co-fund subsidy request: MarketBridge channel listing + risk-transfer credit

Thanks — quick operational notes + one ask from RevOps: 

- Execution: If we greenlight, RevOps needs the Annex and the final SOW 10 business days before listing live to configure the credit and billing rules in the console.
- Controls: Credits should be issued as a one-time invoice credit tied to the partner listing line item; do not issue manual refunds.
- Tracking: Require MarketBridge to provide monthly reporting on referral conversions against an agreed KPIs spreadsheet; failure to supply report is grounds for withholding the subsidy.

On signoff authority: I support Lauren's conditional approval language. From an ops POV I recommend we include the following clause in the Annex: 

  "Partner co-fund is payable only after verification of listing live + first referral event; subsidy subject to prorated clawback if partner-delisted before 9 months."

If Finance approves on the conditions Lauren outlined and Legal signs off on the Annex language, RevOps can operationalize within the requested timeline.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel co-fund subsidy request: MarketBridge channel listing + risk-transfer credit — APPROVED (conditions)

Team & Dana — I can approve the commercial under the conditions below. This serves as VP/CFO signoff in principle for up to $50k of co-fund subsidy. Please ensure Legal and RevOps include the clauses before execution.

Conditions for approval (must be in final Annex / SOW):
1) Subsidy: Redwood to pay 50% of MarketBridge listing fee, capped at $50,000, paid as a credit after validation of listing live + first referral event. Payment to be expensed to marketing and amortized over the 6-month eligibility window.
2) Minimum spend: Customer commit of $200,000 over 12 months; if minimum not met, discount reduces to 0% and standard overage pricing applies; any subsidy shall be prorated and clawed back based on time on platform (<9 months).
3) Partner fee exposure: If MarketBridge listing fee is recurring, Redwood liability limited to one year unless renewed by explicit exec signoff.
4) Reporting & verification: MarketBridge to deliver monthly referral KPIs; lack of reporting authorizes Redwood to withhold subsidy.
5) Execution timeline: Annex + SOW executed and provided to RevOps minimum 10 business days before listing go-live; RevOps to confirm billing config prior to live date.

Once Legal has the Annex language I will countersign. Aisha — please coordinate with Dana to get the Annex drafted and push the HubSpot deal to "Pending Legal" when ready. Karthik/Marissa — please track the Ops checklist.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance (acting CFO) — Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
